name: chondrodendron tomentosum root + lycopodium clavatum spore + saw palmetto
purpose: Purpose For relief of difficult urination; prostate afflictions.
uses: Suggested use In acute disorders, take 10 drops in pure water every hour until improvement is felt. Then take 25 drops in pure water three times daily after or between meals.
otcwarn: Warnings If pregnant or breast-feeding, consult a health professional before use.
